reviews.title: One of the best for Safety and peace of mind
reviews.comment: A bit on the expensive side but it’s the best. The build quality, the ease of use, and installation was all extremely easy. I am a first time builder so this was glorious for my very first GPU definitely recommend alone for the pin sensing. I keep it on the background and monitor it as I am doing my workloads on Blender and Divinci resolve as well as Solidworks. This thing is a work horse through and through.
reviews.author: Paul

reviews.title: Fantastic but expensive..
reviews.comment: This GPU is not for everyone. Performance is like every other 5090 because it has the same chipset from Nvidia. Temperature - if you have enough fans in your PC case obviously won't overheat or be hot in the PC case. The design of the GPU, honestly, it could be better and less heavy. If you want something that is the top, the best, and the most expensive, just to show off, yes this GPU will help with that. But if you don't want to pay almost $4,000, taxes included, then find a cheaper 5090.
reviews.author: EzzeKillz

reviews.title: Insane Performance, Totally Worth It
reviews.comment: Super impressed with this card. It runs everything I throw at it on max settings without even trying, and it stays pretty quiet too. Temps are solid, build feels really premium. It is huge and expensive, but honestly if you’re going for a high-end setup, it’s totally worth it.

reviews.comment: Do not buy 5090’s from this retailer. ASUS  refuses RMA if you buy the card through BB. Having a retailer deal with RMA is a nightmare.
